title.en: Range slider with a value bubble

summary.zh-TW: 拖曳方塊調整價格上限，上方的數值泡泡跟著移動，拖得快時會往反方向傾斜、放開後彈回。也可以點軌道或用方向鍵調整。
summary.en: Drag the thumb to set a price limit; the value bubble follows, leaning away when you drag fast and springing back on release. Click the track or use arrow keys too.

text.zh-TW: 方塊只能左右拖、不能拖出軌道。拖曳時用目前的 x 換算成數值，同時更新填色和泡泡的文字。
text.en: The thumb only moves horizontally within the track. The current x converts to a value and updates the fill and bubble text.

text.zh-TW: deltaX 是這一格畫面移動了多少（約等於速度）。拖得越快泡泡傾斜越多，方向相反，像被甩在後面；用 quickTo 讓角度平順。
text.en: deltaX is how far it moved this frame — roughly speed. Faster drags tilt the bubble more, leaning backwards; quickTo keeps the angle smooth.

text.zh-TW: 數值對齊到每 5 一格。拖曳時顯示對齊後的數值，放開時方塊也滑到那一格的位置。
text.en: Values snap to steps of 5. The bubble shows the snapped value while dragging, and the thumb settles onto that step on release.

text.zh-TW: 自製的滑桿要補上語意：讀屏軟體才會唸出「滑桿，200 美元」，方向鍵、Shift、Home／End 都能操作。
text.en: A custom slider needs semantics so screen readers announce “slider, $200”; arrow keys, Shift, Home and End all work.
